# NetSuite CPQ Ecommerce Integration

NetSuite CPQ Ecommerce Integration (5 pages): NetSuite CPQ Ecommerce Integration

## Chapters
- [NetSuite CPQ Ecommerce Integration](article_3102531504.md): Note: Install NetSuite CPQ Configurator to use NetSuite CPQ Ecommerce Integration.
  - [Testing and Debugging the Conversion into Configured Items](article_1165654492.md): Before writing the server-side script to start the conversion into configured items, you can test and debug the process.
  - [Converting Transaction Line Items into Configured Items with a Single Scheduled Script Call](article_4121707492.md): When converting transaction line items into configured items using NetSuite CPQ Ecommerce Integration, you should process as much line items as possible in a single call to the SuiteApp scheduled script (CPQE-SC-BCL script, ID customscript\cpqe\sc\bcl) for better performance.
